paired_universe: intersection of cached K562 perturbations, cached RPE1 perturbations, and EstablishedOBS71 identities
common_response_axis: K562/RPE1 gene intersection minus every perturbation target in the paired universe

component_rules.coverage_strong: both directions ZERO_90_MINUS_ZERO_10 >= 0.10, CI lower > 0, and >=4/5 seed differences positive
component_rules.coverage_weak: both directions ZERO_90_MINUS_ZERO_10 < 0.05 and CI upper < 0.10
component_rules.anchor_direction_clear: ANCHOR_90_MINUS_ZERO_90 >= 0.05 and CI lower > 0; ANCHOR_MINUS_SHUFFLE_90 >= 0.05 and CI lower > 0; >=4/5 seed differences positive for both
component_rules.anchor_supported: anchor_direction_clear in both directions and aligned mean exceeds zero and shuffle at >=4/6 coverage levels in both directions
component_rules.anchor_partial: anchor_direction_clear in exactly one direction, or aligned>zero is clear in both but identity specificity is not clear in both
component_rules.anchor_not_supported: ANCHOR_90_MINUS_ZERO_90 CI upper < 0.05 in both directions
component_rules.overall_partial: anchor supported or partial, unless coverage strong and anchor is not supported
component_rules.overall_not_supported: coverage strong and anchor not supported

cell_budget_control: CELL_BUDGET_CONTROL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: paired source-level K562 cache lacks cell counts; do not create a new multi-gigabyte cell-level pseudobulk pipeline
